phy-async-audit 1.0.0

- Initial release of phy-async-audit: an async/await error handling auditor for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Go.
- Scans codebases for ten common patterns of unhandled async errors, including floating promises, missing try/catch in route handlers, Promise.all without error boundaries, and ignored errors in goroutines.
- Designed to help developers catch silent crashes and production-only bugs caused by unhandled async failures.
- Operates with zero external dependencies and supports easy invocation for CI or manual audit.
- Full detection coverage and usage instructions detailed in SKILL.md.
